subject_definitions
<Subject 1>: The adult lead rider from the character sheet <Picture 1>, riding a bay horse.
<Subject 2>: A second adult female rider, from the character sheet <Picture 2>, riding a black horse. Keep both riders, their mounts, saddles, and reins consistent across cuts.

summary
[reference generation] A 10-second, 16:9 photorealistic equestrian racing scene. Two riders exit the final bend; <Subject 1> accelerates alongside her companion, they cross the finish almost level, then begin gradually easing their horses in a long run-out. Fast real-time action throughout, with no slow motion.

retention_analysis
<Picture 1>: fully_preserved for <Subject 1>'s identity and reference styling. Do not reproduce the character-sheet layout or background. Generate <Subject 2>, both horses, tack, and the outdoor training track.

detailed_description
Cinematic realism on a wide, well-maintained outdoor sand training track in clear late-afternoon light. Soft golden side light keeps faces readable, with natural skin, detailed moving fabric, and fine dust illuminated behind the horses; the distant green tree line remains subdued.

[Shot 1] Wide three-quarter view from outside the final bend, showing both complete horses and riders as they exit onto the straight, traveling screen left to right. Make a short, fast tracking pan that reveals the straight ahead. <Subject 2> on the black horse leads by half a horse length; <Subject 1> follows on the bay in a separate parallel lane. As the curve opens, <Subject 1> looks ahead toward the finish, lowers her torso slightly into a balanced forward riding position, and gives a brief leg cue. Her horse lengthens its galloping stride and begins closing the small gap. Maintain clear lateral separation, distinct hoof contacts, and matching rider balance through each stride. Sand scatters backward from the hooves.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, cut to a medium-wide lateral tracking shot moving at approximately the horses' speed, retaining both horses' full bodies and their riders. The fence posts and trees pass rapidly behind them with convincing parallax. <Subject 1>'s bay draws level with the black horse without crossing its path. Her hands follow the horse's head movement through elastic rein contact; her hips and knees absorb the gallop instead of bouncing rigidly. Both riders focus ahead. Around the seventh second, their horses cross a thin white finish stripe almost together, between two fixed upright marker posts. Keep the finish crossing clearly visible in this shot. No winner is announced.

[Shot 3] At 00:07.500, cut to a close side tracking view of <Subject 1>'s face and upper body, including her hands and a portion of her horse's neck; her companion remains visible slightly farther away. Beyond the finish, she begins sitting a little taller and gently gathering the reins. The horses continue forward into the spacious run-out, gradually easing their pace rather than stopping suddenly. She briefly turns toward her companion, exhales, and gives a breathless, delighted smile, then looks forward again.

Playback remains real-time from beginning to end, including the final reaction. No slow motion, speed ramps, suspended galloping, or frozen dust. Preserve horse anatomy, saddle contact, continuous reins, and consistent travel direction. No collisions, jumps, dialogue, subtitles, or readable logos.

overall_soundscape
Rapid, distinct hoofbeats on sand, synchronized horse breathing, light tack movement, rushing air, and the rider's breathless exhale. Hoofbeat intervals gradually widen after the finish as the horses ease their pace.

non_diegetic_music
N/A.
